page.content:
Revenge tragedy of the prince, the ghost, Claudius, and Ophelia at Elsinore.

How Hamlet connects

  • Creator: William Shakespeare — William Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.
  • Character: Hamlet (prince) — The prince is the title figure of Hamlet.
  • Character: Ophelia — Ophelia is the court daughter whose death follows Hamlet's revenge plot.
  • Character: Claudius — Claudius is the usurping king Hamlet is charged to kill.
  • Concept: Shakespearean tragedy — Hamlet is a central Shakespearean tragedy.
  • Location: Globe Theatre — Hamlet was staged at the Globe by Shakespeare's company.

What is Hamlet?

Hamlet is the Denmark play: a prince charged by his father's ghost to kill King Claudius, a court that includes Ophelia and Polonius, and the most quoted soliloquies in the Folio.

Key threads lead to William Shakespeare, Hamlet (prince), Ophelia, Claudius, Shakespearean tragedy and Globe Theatre.
